body:
16 Nov 2026, P2-25 slices 2+3: THE LUCENE CROSS-CHECK, exactly what was compared (answers the 16 Nov 23:34 correction note).
WHAT THE EARLIER HELPER LEFT: the predecessor claimed in a comment that it read Lucene's sources at releases/lucene/10.3.2. Evidence found on disk: its scratch folder holds ArabicNormalizer.java, ArabicNormalizationFilter.java, PersianNormalizer.java, PersianNormalizationFilter.java and PersianCharFilter.java. I re-fetched the same five files (read-only, raw.githubusercontent.com, tag releases/lucene/10.3.2, path lucene/analysis/common/src/java/org/apache/lucene/analysis/{ar,fa}/) and compared SHA-256: all five are byte-identical. So the sources WERE read, and are what the tag holds.
ONE LABEL WAS WRONG and is fixed: 8241bb80dc7f3ef1be6f222f40cc6cbfa9a9aa98 is the ANNOTATED TAG object (the GitHub ref API returns type "tag"); the COMMIT it points to is dadfd90b4401947f4d0387669dc94999fbb2c830 (tag message "Lucene 10.3.2 release", 17 Nov 2025). The test, textnorm.py and the fixture's "lucene" note now name both.
COMPARED, each as a test row against textnorm.fold (tests/test_textnorm.py, test_every_mapping_of_lucenes_arabic_and_persian_filters_is_in_the_fold): every case branch of ArabicNormalizer.normalize (3 alef forms to alef, alef maksura to yeh, teh marbuta to heh, tatweel and the 8 vowel marks deleted = 14 rows) and of PersianNormalizer.normalize (Farsi yeh and yeh barree to yeh, keheh to kaf, heh with yeh above and heh goal to heh, the hamza above deleted = 6 rows), plus PersianCharFilter (the zero-width non-joiner becomes a space), plus the fact that neither folds the hamza seats (kept apart here too). All rows agree.
THIS FOLD IS A SUPERSET: it also folds alef wasla and removes U+0653-065F, U+0670 and the Quranic marks, which Lucene leaves.
NOT COMPARED: Lucene's own unit tests, its stemmers, the order of an analyzer chain, ICU folding, any other Lucene release. The Arabic table is therefore "checked against these three classes of one release", not "agrees with Lucene".
The fixture note (app/test/fixtures/text/fold-cases.json, "lucene") no longer says "not checked"; a test fails if it does.
